_metadata.description: Portal Everywhere mandatory acceptance obligations; planned evidence is not completion.

requirements.title: Local host identity
requirements.description: Given the companion host differs from the Portal API host, when the user selects This machine, portal shall ensure: The descriptor identifies the companion host.

validation.notes: Implement acceptance case CAT-01 in the portal producer suite. Required assertion: The descriptor identifies the companion host. Retain producer receipt, source fingerprint, and applicable live support row. No passing evidence exists yet.
